Video Title: Uniswap Surges Over 200%: Testing Extreme Bubble Resistance and TWAP Gravity  
Video ID: En58_cumL1M  
Uniswap (UNI) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
- Current trading price sits near $10, a level that is more than twice the 20‑week simple moving average of $426 and has recently spiked to a short‑term high of $927.  
- The 20‑week SMA is hovering at $426, placing UNI in a precarious zone just below the SMA and above the time‑weighted average price of $960.  
- Composite risk score is 64/100, with gravity risk at 21/100, down from a peak of 5 at the end of 2024.  
- Social sentiment word‑cloud momentum is dominated by bullish narratives, with a 7‑day up of 18% and a 30‑day rally of 116%, positioning UNI as the top performer in the top‑20 crypto cap list.

Macro Quantitative Risk  
- TWAP baseline is anchored at $960; UNI has recently breached this level, creating a temporary resistance that has been broken.  
- Regression fair‑value band places UNI at an overvaluation of roughly $15, with a maximum euphoria target between $10 and $1489.  
- The asset is currently in an “extreme bubble” zone (±2 σ) with a price range of $7–$10.13; any move above $10 signals heightened risk.  
- Undervaluation residuals are minimal; the regression channel suggests a non‑panic bear floor near $6.70 and a base‑case ceiling at $15.

Downside & Upside Targets  
- Machine‑learning models project a higher probability of mean reversion than a sustained bull run; the short‑term escape ceiling could reach $220 before a pullback.  
- Panic‑drawdown support floor is estimated at $6.70, while the non‑panic floor sits at $11.  
- Macro moving‑average support remains at the 20‑week SMA of $426, with a potential cycle bull target near $15.  
- ROI outlook: current year ROI is positive 60%, compared to the last bear market’s negative 67%; the year‑to‑date ROI has surged to a peak of 67%.

Macro moving‑average supports include the 50‑day SMA at $5.80 and the 200‑day SMA at $4.90, both acting as potential short‑term floors. The cycle bull target, derived from the gravity model, is set at $14.50, representing the maximum euphoria level before a likely correction.
